message: ハクを愛する
Despite throwing herself on the line for the decoy operation, it's been one failure after another.
And while all that's going on, Sacchin ended up getting nabbed again.

name: Synn
message: 「At this point, what if we ask Sacchin to be the decoy?」

name: Misa
message: 「No, we can't do that! It's far too dangerous for Takahashi-san. So no... we simply cannot...」
I know. I know that. Still, I can't bear to put Misa through any more embarrassment.

name: Synn
message: 「In that case...」

name: Misa
message: 「I... I have no choice but to do it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nnnngh... In that case, I really have no choice but to do it!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun...?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll do it!! I'll be the decoy!!」
Both as president and as a guy, I can't let Misa be the only one subjected to such humiliation!

name: Misa
message: 「You'll... do it... you say?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, just leave it to me.」

name: Misa
message: 「Very well, I accept.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Accept?」

name: Misa
message: 「Your challenge... I have received it loud and clear!!」

name: Synn
message: 「How'd you get that out of this!?」

name: Misa
message: 「You're claiming that you can lure the culprit out, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I mean, I'd consider myself lucky if that happened, yeah...」

name: Misa
message: 「And if, purely hypothetically, mind you!? If the culprit actually shows up, then it's your win. I'll admit defeat gracefully.」

name: Synn
message: 「This is about winning and losing!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Let's see who can properly fulfill their duty as the decoy--it's a match!!」
Looks like the only way to get her to agree is to settle things once and for all...

name: Synn
message: 「Got it... You're on.」

name: Misa
message: 「I will definitely win!!」
Still, I'm glad Misa is back to her usual self.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's set the trap right away.」

name: Misa
message: 「In that case, I think it would be best to start by using this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
Saying that, what she held out was a piece of striped fabric.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, isn't this Misa's p-p-pan--!」
I can't say it!

name: Misa
message: 「I-Idiot!! It's completely unused, so it's fine!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「He's disappointed.」

name: Synn
message: 「I am not, and that's beside the point! We don't even have to use the same kind of underwear!\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「If we don't, it won't be a fair match, will it!?」
Has Misa's pride really been backed into a corner that badly...?

name: Helena
message: 「A fair match, huh... Has a nice ring to it.」
Helena-san appeared while pretending to puff on a cigar.

name: Helena
message: 「Here you go, a little souvenir. Take it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Th-This is...」

name: Misa
message: 「Bloomers!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Keeping them even after graduating... Maybe she just really likes bloomers.」

name: Helena
message: 「Sounds like you want to get expelled.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I didn't mean to make you mad! Please forgive me!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Teehee. They're not mine--they're genuinely a current student's bloomers~\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「You can figure out the rest, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry, Paqy.」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Onee-sama's bloomers...\s04」
Aah, these are the bloomers Ria-senpai wears. Just holding them makes my palms start sweating.

name: Misa
message: 「That's right! With this, we should be able to have a fair match!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, using Big Sister's bloomers for a contest...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah... No matter how you look at it, this feels kind of bad, or rather, wrong...」

name: Helena
message: 「If you explain the situation, I'm sure she'll understand.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「If you say so, Helena-san... then I guess that's true!」

name: Helena
message: 「I appreciate your obedience! Now then, I hereby order the Student Council to apprehend the culprit.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, leave it to us!」

name: Helena
message: 「I pray for your success.」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright... let's do our best.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on a moment.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」

name: Misa
message: 「Rather than letting Big Sister's sacred bloomers be defiled by Sakura-kun--」

name: Misa
message: 「I shall have the honor of wearing them first!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, sure, whatever.」
I wipe the sweat off on my pants so she won't notice before handing them over to Misa.

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister's...\s04」
I wonder if Misa actually has a crush on Ria-senpai.

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, hold on!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you changing into them right here?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? Ah... ahhh--I let my guard down!!」
What would've happened if I hadn't stopped her...\s03

name: Misa
message: 「Ahhh, ahhhh, go away!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!?」

name: Misa
message: 「I can't change while you're watching, can I!?」

name: Synn
message: 「There's a changing room right there, why don't you just go use that...」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-You're right. Sorry. I'll be right back.」
Ba-dump, ba-dump... Misa is way too bold...\s03

name: Paqy
message: 「O-Oh... Felt like I was havin' a pretty nice dream.」

name: Synn
message: 「Morning, Paqy. What kind of dream were you having?」

name: Paqy
message: 「My dark rims are made out of Ria-chan's bloomers... huff, huff.」
The Great Sage is way too lofty for me to understand.

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, not that I want an old hag's bloomers anyway.」
Seems like he somehow misunderstood.

name: Misa
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Alright.」
No, no! What do I mean 'alright'?!

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... I'm pretty doubtful you actually put 'em on.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-Wha--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Let's have her show us some proof, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeh?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lift up the hem of your skirt and hold it in your mouth. That'll put everything in plain sight, hehehe...」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-Th-That's...」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to, you don't have to!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then it won't be a fair match.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that right?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't go along with it!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy-san...」
Misa stares at Paqy with a look that's both stern and slack.
Inside her head, a colorful jumble of thoughts like mixed vegetables must be swirling around.

name: Paqy
message: 「Hehehe... Can you really bring yourself to punch the great me, who looks just like Blackuma?」

name: Misa
message: 「Blackuma would never say things like that!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're always flashin' your bloomers anyway. Why get embarrassed about it now?」

name: Misa
message: 「I know that. But... but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You don't have to cry...」

name: Misa
message: 「As if I'd cry!! You just want me to show you, right?! Show you!!」
Saying that, Misa pinched the hem of her skirt with her fingers.

name: Synn
message: 「N... No way!?」
She swiftly lifts her skirt up and drops it back down.
Even knowing they're bloomers, having them flashed at me like that is surprisingly--no, bad, bad!

name: Misa
message: 「*Pant, pant*... That satisfies you, right?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Where's Ria-chan?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kyaaaah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Now, now. I saw them clearly, so it's all good.」

name: Misa
message: 「It is NOT all goooood!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, come on. We gotta hurry up and set the trap.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph.」
With a face like she had just eaten bitter melon for the first time, Misa disappeared into the changing room.
Still, she could've just taken them off when she changed, so why did she go out of her way to come back here?

name: Paqy
message: 「Time's up.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not coming, huh~」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. If Sakura-kun fails too, then we're even, even.」
Even backed onto a ledge with zero chance of winning, she refuses to drop her tough act.

name: Misa
message: 「Here you go.」
Misa hands me her bloomers. Having a girl do something like this really makes my heart pound~.
Besides, Misa was just wearing these a moment ago... over her underwear?
Could it be she was wearing them directly without anything underneath--
Ahhhhhh, I'm the Student Council President, so I must not get all worked up over something like this, no, no!

name: Synn
message: 「A-Alriiight. Well then, I'm off~」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm back.」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Show me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's telling you to take off your pants.」

name: Misa
message: 「I am not!! I'm just checking to make sure you're actually wearing them!!」
I'd love to say I just left them behind when I changed--except I kind of had a hunch she'd say something like this.
Still, when it actually comes down to dropping my pants in front of a girl, it takes some serious courage and guts.
Plus, what I'm exposing are bloomers, putting me on the fast track to pervert-ville. If anyone else sees me like this, I'll never be able to get married.
On top of that, the sheer immorality of wearing bloomers has been eating away at my mind for a while now.
It's eating away at my male pride.

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-Whoa, got it!」
Alright! At a time like this, I've got no choice but to be a man and steel myself!!

name: Misa
message: 「Hurry up and show me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? Give me just a little longer to mentally prepare--」
By Misa's own hand, my bloomers are laid bare.

name: Ria
message: 「Y-You two...」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sister?!」
Ria-senpai covered her face with her palms, though there were huge gaps between her fingers.

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan, what are you doing?!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nooo! Don't look, Sister!」

name: Ria
message: 「S-Synn-kun, why are you wearing bloomers?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugyaaa!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even a blushing Ria-chan is cute!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「No mercy, huh...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm your senior, so I have to scold you both nice and hard!」

name: Ria
message: 「L-Listen up, you two! Even if you're free to date whoever you want, y-you know!」

name: Ria
message: 「Y-You mustn't do, um... perverted things so openly like this!」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan! You can't just go pulling a boy's pants down!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun! You're a boy, so you can't go around wearing bloomers!」
I-I got scolded...

name: Ria
message: 「D-D-Do you understand now?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yesh.」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-Then that's fine!」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun! If we leave it like this, she's going to keep misunderstanding us in a weird way! Are you okay with that?!」

name: Synn
message: 「That would be bad!」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai... there's a very, very deep reason why things ended up like this--」

name: Ria
message: 「No... excuses!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's true! Even I wouldn't wear bloomers for no reason! Don't you think it's weird that I'm wearing bloomers?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you going quiet there!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Because... they surprisingly look good on you...\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「Onee-sama is complimenting him...」
That's what makes you jealous!?

name: Misa
message: 「Give them back!! I'll prove that they look better on me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Forget about the bloomers already!! More importantly, as for why I'm doing this--」
And so on and so forth.

name: Ria
message: 「I-Is that how it was~? Ahh, thank goodness. I jumped to conclusions, didn't I? I'm sorry, *bow*」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I just thought I'd try devising various strategies, and so...」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, Misa-chan doing *that* to Synn-kun's pants... I think that's... going a bit too far, okay?」
Misa is stomping her feet in frustration.

name: Misa
message: 「I'd like to redeem my honor, but it's Sakura-kun's turn right now. Hurry up and go set the trap.」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Got it.」
More than redeeming myself, I just want to clear my name.

name: Ria
message: 「'TIME UP!!'」

name: Synn
message: 「No good after all, huh...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. That makes us even.」

name: Ria
message: 「Wasn't the whole point to catch the culprit?\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, of course that's our real goal! That's why we've been trying every trick in the book!」

name: Paqy
message: 「How pathetic! Miss Hysterical acting all triumphant for no reason, and Synn-sama pitching a tent over an old hag's bloomers.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's vulgar, Paqy!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「In the end, both of you just made total fools of yourselves and didn't solve a damn thing.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's why, next time... next time for sure!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're one stubborn woman who doesn't know when to quit. Leave the next move to yours truly.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What are you planning to do, Paqy?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks like the Great Sage Paqy-sama has no choice but to step up and bare it all!」
Paqy rummages around through his own body.
And what he pulls out is--
Briefs!?

name: Synn
message: 「Even though you're a plushie!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「What you'd call... lucky underwear!」

name: Ria
message: 「Giggle. Talking about luck and competition--Paa-chan, you're just like Misa-chan.」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No way...」
Personality-wise she doesn't want to be lumped in with him, yet she wears a complicated expression showing she's not entirely displeased either.

name: Paqy
message: 「Watch closely, Ria-chan. Yours truly is gonna prove he's a real man.」

name: Ria
message: 「Good luck~\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy-san... thump-thump...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Why?」
Well, there's no way something like that could actually work--

name: Taishou
message: 「Eee!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehhh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「He took the bait!?」

name: Misa
message: 「So a demon really was the culprit after all...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh, a piece of cake for yours truly. Now, hand it over.」

name: Taishou
message: 「Eee!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hades!!」
It doesn't seem like it has any intention of returning Paqy's underwear. Not that it needs to.

name: Synn
message: 「However, this is as far as you go...! You were the culprit, weren't you? Why would you do something like--」

name: Taishou
message: 「Eee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!」

name: Misa
message: 「We're not trying to take your underwear, so calm down!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Screw that! That's my Sunday best, ya know!? Right, Ria-chan!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't ask me~\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「For now, we have to calm it down... Let's go, everyone!」
